_about: Section notes that POINT at other food instead of describing the dishes under them (roadmap 080/280). tag_allergens.py does not add allergen tags from a flagged note. Kept here, not in site/data/, because no screen renders the flag (ADR 0047). `note` is the note's exact text: an entry whose note has changed is STALE and fails validate.py and `tag_allergens.py --explain --check`. Flagging never removes a tag already written; `tag_allergens.py --section-notes` lists those for review.

pointers.note: The board also says: see our cabinet of fresh filled paninis, savouries, slices and cakes.
pointers.why: Refers the reader to the cabinet sections; it says nothing about what the lunch dishes are made of.
